expectations.text: Puts most promotion effort into the final week
expectations.evidence: The effort order says 'Owned-channel promotion, with most of it in each episode's final week.' The transcript backs this with Livestorm data: 49.6% of registrations arrive in the final 7 days and 15.3% on the day. It also applies the rule to episode 1, placing 'the main promotion push the week of 2027-01-05', the week before the 2027-01-12 session.

expectations.text: Puts most promotion effort into the final week
expectations.evidence: Real registration opens about 3 weeks before each session. The plan puts the owned-channel push and the LinkedIn test in 'Weeks 4–6'. The response never says to concentrate promotion in the final week. It comes close in two places: it notes that 'Late registrants show up at the highest rate', and it sends reminders at T-24h, T-1h and T-10min. Those reminders target people who have already registered, so they are attendance nudges rather than promotion. The promotion is spread over several weeks instead of weighted toward the final week.
